description: Observed LocalMaxxing leaderboard run. Evidence for compatibility, not an executable launch contract.

localmaxxing.notes:
First DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 (re-post-trained, same 284B/13B arch) on 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (SM120). Backend: FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV4 attn + flashinfer_cutlass MoE (voipmonitor 'lucifer-cutlass'), NOT b12x. Native DSpark draft head, K5 (dspark_block_size=5 is baked into config.json = hard ceiling).

WORKLOAD: tokSOut 276.0 is single-stream CODE generation, to stay comparable with the other 2x RTX PRO 6000 DSpark runs here. Same runs gave prose 149.8 and math 285.8 t/s - prose is ~46% below code on this stack, so workload choice dominates any hardware difference.

METHOD: greedy (temp 0), thinking=false, two-point decode (64 vs 896 max_tokens on a prefix-warmed identical prompt) so prefill cancels. Mean of 3 runs; spread ~7%. Code prompt = 'commented B-tree with insert/search/delete plus a test harness'. tokSPrefill measured separately as TTFT on a 107,016-token prompt (10.24 s). Short-prompt TTFT 63 ms. peakVramGb is PER CARD, measured: 96799/96917 MiB of 97887 MiB at gpu-memory-utilization 0.93.

VS PREDECESSOR: re-benched the older DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark checkpoint on this exact stack, same session, fresh-vs-fresh, 3 runs each: code 262.6 / prose 155.0 / math 274.9. So 0731 is ~5% faster on code, ~4% on math, ~3% slower on prose - net a wash. 0731 ran on a COLD JIT/autotune cache vs the predecessor's warm one, so it's if anything understated. Spec acceptance unchanged: 48.6% (2.43 per 5-token draft) vs 49.9% (2.50).

CONTEXT: server configured at the full 262144 (not 2048), and the decode figure above is with that KV budget allocated. Cold prefill of a 211,722-token prompt takes 34.6 s (~6.1k tok/s - prefill throughput degrades with length; the 10.4k tok/s above is at 107k). A repeat of the same prompt returns in 0.9 s on the prefix cache. Config allows 1M, but fp8 weights (~81 GiB/card at TP2) cap usable KV at 256k on 2 cards.

HOST: ASRock Rack TURIND8UD-2T, Turin ES 64c/128t, 125 GB, Deb13, drv 590.48.01, TP2 over PCIe Gen5 P2P (no NVLink), 600 W/card.
localmaxxing.observed_command: vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 --tensor-parallel-size 2 --decode-context-parallel-size 1 --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --block-size 256 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.93 --max-model-len 262144 --max-num-seqs 64 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --max-cudagraph-capture-size 512 --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","custom_ops":["all"]}' --async-scheduling --enable-chunked-prefill --enable-flashinfer-autotune --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v4 --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":5,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic"}' --attention-backend FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV4 --kernel-config.moe_backend flashinfer_cutlass --enable-prefix-caching
